description: This file defines a class 'Indenter' that manages code indentation for various file types and code structures, including C++, JSON, and manual indentation. It provides methods to process and format code snippets based on file extension or code context.

classes.name: Indenter
classes.description: A class that handles indentation logic for different code formats and file types, including C++, JSON, and manual indentation.

methods.name: indentType
methods.description: Determines the indentation style based on file extension and filename.

methods.name: _collapseBlank
methods.description: Collapses multiple blank lines into a single blank line.

methods.name: _indentCPP
methods.description: Applies C++ style indentation rules to a list of code lines.

methods.name: _indentJSON
methods.description: Applies JSON style indentation rules to a list of code lines.

methods.name: _indentManual
methods.description: Applies manual indentation based on custom markers.

methods.name: processIndent
methods.description: Main method to process code string and return indented code based on current settings.
